comment: Sample-set document for `klt yield`, derived by sim/bin/yield-run.py.
APPEND-ONLY EVIDENCE, not a scratch file: `klt signoff` hashes the
artifact a yield citation's `samples` field names, so this document is
what a citation of the report beside it is pinned to.
WHY THIS SHAPE. `klt yield` reads a `negative_control` from either input
shape it accepts, but `klt sim` has no request-side field for one and
never emits one on its response rollup, so a klt sim response can carry a
negative control only if a committed response is hand-edited -- which
sim/README.md's append-only discipline forbids. Filed upstream as
2AMLogic/klayout-tools#2563. So the two campaigns' own per-sample values
NOTHING HERE IS A NEW MEASUREMENT. Every number below is copied out of a
committed klt sim response, by the same rule klt yield applies to a sim
report itself; the record minted alongside this file asserts that the
nominal leg reproduces the sim-report path's own statistics.

netlist_patch.rationale: Mis-ratio the feedback divider's top leg by +10% (XR_FB_A L=180um -> 198um), moving the ideal regulation point 1.8V -> 1.86V: +3.33%, i.e. 1.67x the ratified +-2% Output window and ~2.8 sigma past its upper edge in the nominal campaign's own measured mismatch sigma of 8.52mV. Chosen as the canonical accuracy defect for this block (a divider ratio error is exactly what a +-2% output-accuracy row is there to catch), deliberately sized to be decisively out of window while still leaving the loop regulating so the samples stay measurable. Applied to the netlisted deck rather than to design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch so the design keeps one source of truth; the asserted occurrence count makes the patch fail loudly if the divider it targets ever changes.

substitutions.match: XR_FB_A VOUT FB 0 sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po W=0.42 L=180 mult=1 m=1
substitutions.replace: XR_FB_A VOUT FB 0 sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po W=0.42 L=198 mult=1 m=1
